forms.title: UK Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) — online application
forms.stoppedAt: Email address (a security code is sent to it); the later steps sit under an application id

steps.name: The easiest way to apply is on the app
notices: By applying on the UK ETA app you're more likely to: complete your application quicker; get a faster decision; it should only take 10 minutes to apply.

To apply on the app you will need: to take a photo of yourself - if you're applying for someone else, they must be with you; the passport you will use to travel to the UK; a credit card, debit card, Apple Pay or Google Pay

steps.name: Help downloading the UK ETA app
notices: You should apply online if: you cannot download the app on your phone; the person you are applying for is not with you

steps.name: How to apply
notices: Take or upload a photo of the passport you will use to travel to the UK. Scan your face with your device, if it has a camera. Children aged 9 and under will not be asked to scan their face. Take or upload a photo of yourself. Answer some questions about yourself. Pay for your application.
You will need to complete your application in one go - you cannot save your progress.
If you do not do anything for 20 minutes, the service will time out. Your answers will be deleted and you will need to start again.
By applying, you agree to the Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) privacy notice.

notices: We will send a security code to this email address to check you can use it.
